Two findings.

**F1 — Full captures silently omit removed cells.** [capture.mjs:443](capture.mjs:443)

The loop skips a cell whose node is gone, so the capture looks complete.

Replace the loop with:

```js
for (const cell of cells) {
  if (!cell.node) { missing.push(cell.id); continue; }
  capture(cell);
}
```

- **F2 — Anchoring hints are wrong for two profiles.** [facts.mjs:49](facts.mjs:49)

Drop the hint for stretch profiles.
